acceptance_signals: A repository-binding policy failure during Governance MCP construction produces a bounded actionable stderr message and a stable nonzero exit.
No non-protocol output is written to stdout on either success or startup failure.
Successful initialize and tools/list behavior remains unchanged.
The implementation does not add or modify Git safe.directory configuration and does not bypass Git ownership checks.
Focused governance MCP and Codex hook tests pass.
Affected current-state documentation and the dated development log accurately record the verified behavior and remaining limits.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-12596e4a8d03432e98dcc0dc09d9f2ae and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: When Governance MCP startup cannot bind the selected working directory to a valid Git worktree, convert the existing repository policy exception into a bounded actionable stderr diagnostic and stable nonzero CLI exit while preserving protocol-only stdout and all existing successful MCP behavior.

items: Catching the exception too broadly could hide unrelated startup failures.
Including raw Git stderr could expose absolute paths or host identity, so diagnostics must use bounded product-owned wording.
Changing repository validation semantics could weaken fail-closed ownership protection; this task must not change those semantics.
Reviewed assumption: The observed Git dubious-ownership failure is an environment and fixture-ownership issue, not an MCP protocol defect.
Reviewed assumption: CodexHookPolicyError is the existing bounded exception type for repository-binding policy failures.
Reviewed assumption: A narrow CLI exception boundary is sufficient without changing GovernanceMcpServer protocol code.

Reviewed unknown: Whether a future dedicated repository-binding exception type is preferable to reusing CodexHookPolicyError is an implementation detail to resolve within the admitted scope without changing behavior.

title: Expose bounded repository-binding failures during Governance MCP startup
